name: Victoria
source:
Victoria is a highly experienced chef that runs her own food truck business in town. Her father Danny is a semi-famous chef who has his own restaurant in Sunshine Bay, and he is very protective of Victoria. She has two older brothers who are also protective of their younger sister.

Victoria and her family are of latino descent and they emigrated to Sunshine Bay when she was in her early-teens.
